issues.desc: Vacancy 2008-02-29..2008-03-12 in the new 여성부. 여성가족부 was abolished on 2008-02-29 and 장하진 was not kept as a holdover 국무위원. Nominee 이춘호 had withdrawn on 2008-02-24 and 변도윤 was appointed on 2008-03-13. The gazette dates vice minister 이인식's appointment 2008-03-01, so who acted on 2008-02-29 itself is not documented.

Vacancy 2014-06-14..2014-07-15 after 조윤선 left to become 청와대 정무수석. Vice minister 이복실 acted (transcripts, 연합뉴스 2014-07-11). The start of the vacancy depends on 조윤선's end date, which rests on her 이임식 (2014-06-13) and the ministry page, because the formal date of her 면직 or 정무수석 appointment was not found.

Vacancy 2024-02-22..2025-09-09 (19 months). 김현숙 left on 2024-02-21 (면직 effective 2024-02-22) and 윤석열 named no successor. Vice minister 신영숙 acted through the 2025-06-04 transition until 원민경 was appointed on 2025-09-10. Two nominees in between withdrew (none under 윤석열 after 김행, 강선우 under 이재명 in 2025-07).

The 2001-01-29 reshuffle, including 한명숙's appointment as the first 여성부장관, is missing from the gazette table-of-contents index and so from harvest/gazette_text. The verifier found the notice in the whole-issue PDF of 관보 제14717호 (published 2001-02-02), under ◉2001년 1 월29일자 with 진념 and 한완상, so her start is gazette-backed. The same notice also covers the finance and education lineages.

Holdover and exit dates on 2008-02-28 (장하진) follow the offices.json convention for ministries abolished by 법률 제8852호. The ministry page and ko.wikipedia give 2008-02-29. She attended the 2008-02-27 cabinet meeting and was called 'former minister' on 2008-03-01. The day her resignation was accepted was not found.

Several ends are set to the successor's gazette date because the day the resignation was accepted was not reported (지은희, 변도윤, 백희영, 김희정, 이정옥, 정영애). The ministry page uses the day before the successor in each case, and some 이임식 were held a day or more earlier (지은희 2005-01-04, 이정옥 2020-12-28, 정영애 2022-05-09).

Hanja discrepancies. The gazette prints 池銀嬉 (지은희) and 鄭鉉栢 (정현백), while ko.wikipedia prints 池銀姬 and 鄭鉉柏. The gazette text drops the middle glyph of 강은희's name (姜  姬), and 姜恩姬 is taken from na_members_15_22.csv. The roster follows the gazette where it is legible.

정무장관(제2) (여성정책 portfolio, 1998-02-25..1998-02-27) precedes this lineage functionally, but offices.json assigns it to the 'special' lineage, so its holder is not repeated here. 여성특별위원회 (1998-02-28..2001-01-28) heads were not 국무위원 and are out of scope, so the lineage has no in-scope office between 1998-02-28 and 2001-01-28.

reappointed_on_reorg is false for 장하진 (2005-06-23) and 백희영 (2010-03-19) on the strength of the transitional clauses (no 정무직 exclusion), the absence of a notice in the harvested gazette items and the absence of 임명장 reports. For 2005 the harvested gazette months contain no 여성가족부 personnel item at all, so that absence is weak evidence. 원민경 did receive a new notice for 성평등가족부 dated 2025-10-01. The verifier's whole-issue searches of every gazette issue of 2005-06-23..07-08 and 2010-03-19..04-02 found no reappointment notice for either minister, so the absence no longer rests on the index alone.

English names are Wikidata English labels (tier 4), not official romanizations. 김금래 and 강은희 have no English label and are left null. Birth dates for non-MPs are from ko.wikipedia and Wikidata (tier 4), cross-checked with news profiles where they give a birth year.

At the 2026-09-24 cutoff 원민경 remains 성평등가족부장관 although the President decided to replace her on 2026-08-30. Her designated successor 용혜인 withdrew on 2026-09-13 and no new nominee was found in news through 2026-09-24.

The old panel (data/minister_panel_comprehensive.csv) is wrong for this lineage in many rows. It omits 한명숙's 여성부 spell and 원민경's 여성가족부 spell, lists nominee 김행 as minister 2023-10-12..2025-06-03, extends 김현숙 to 2025-06-03, and gives wrong starts or ends for 지은희, 장하진, 변도윤, 백희영, 김금래, 조윤선, 김희정, 강은희, 정현백, 진선미, 이정옥 and 정영애. All coverage_gaps leads for these ministries are explained by those panel errors or by invalid-type transcript rows.

The MOGEF 역대장관 list (live page, and the 2011 and 2015 archived versions) consistently dates each handover to the day before the successor's appointment and dates 김금래's start to 2011-09-16 in the 2015 version (the approval day). The roster follows the gazette dates and the successor rule, so several ends differ from the ministry list by one day (지은희, 변도윤, 백희영, 김희정, 이정옥, 정영애).

정무장관(제2) 이연숙 (special lineage) is listed on the MOGEF page as serving until 1998.03.02, while the special lineage ends her spell on 1998-02-27 under the 1998 정부조직법 convention. This is a cross-lineage lead for the special verifier, not a change here.
